data.title: Logbook order (Fahrtenbuchauflage) for vehicle BF-MU 412
data.summary: Kreis Beispielförde ordered you to keep a driver's logbook for vehicle BF-MU 412 for six months, because the driver could not be identified after a traffic offence on 14 July 2026. You can object within one month of notification.
data.explanation: The district's traffic office says a traffic offence was committed with your registered car and the driver could not be found. It therefore requires a logbook (Fahrtenbuch) for six months, starting once the decision becomes final (Bestandskraft). You may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person at the Kreis office; the app shows until when. If you do not object in time, the order becomes final. Consider seeking professional advice if you want to contest it.

items.title: Object to the logbook order

date.text: binnen eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist

items.action: File an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person at Kreis Beispielförde if you disagree.
items.consequence: The order becomes final and the six-month logbook duty starts.
